data.narrative:
Heaviside is a Series A-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $28M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 3 same-sector, same-stage private companies—Stark Defence ($4.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M)—supplemented by a broader comp universe of 8 private firms and 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS).

Two triangulation methods were applied. The Stage-Progression method applies a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier from Series A to the next financing round, using the $28M total raised as a proxy base, yielding $56M. The Peer-Median method references the median valuation of the 3 same-stage, same-sector comps at $400M, with a range of $125M to $4.0B. These represent meaningfully different signals: the stage-progression method anchors to capital deployed, while peer-median reflects market pricing of comparable risk-return profiles at this stage in the Defense sector.

The triangulated range spans $48M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $228M across both methods. The width of this band reflects material uncertainty: the peer set exhibits substantial dispersion (10x between min and max), typical of early-stage defense-tech where differentiated IP and customer relationships drive outsized valuation variance. Key sensitivities include customer traction (not specified in available data), defensibility of core tech, and regulatory/export compliance risk inherent to the sector.
